Experience & approach

I connect product direction, human insight and creative execution.

For 25 years, I’ve led product, UX and creative work for brands and organisations across mental health, energy, finance, commerce, sustainability and the public sector. I bring user evidence, business priorities and delivery realities together, giving teams a clear direction they can act on.

At Moriyama, I lead UX and creative direction across complex digital programmes. My approach starts with people: understand their needs through research, turn the evidence into confident product decisions, and create accessible, engaging interfaces that feel clear and true to the brand. I use AI and automation when they strengthen that process, with people retaining judgement and accountability.

What I bring

Four disciplines. One joined-up product approach.

  1. 01

    Digital strategy

    I work with founders, C-suite leaders and senior teams to turn business ambition into a practical digital direction. I connect commercial goals, user evidence and technical realities, then define the proposition, priorities, investment case and roadmap teams can deliver.

    • C-suite advisory
    • Product vision
    • Roadmaps & investment
    • Digital transformation
  2. 02

    User research & insight

    I use interviews, usability testing, analytics and behavioural evidence to uncover the needs behind the brief, then keep those insights present through design and delivery.

    • Interviews & testing
    • Analytics & behaviour
    • Evidence-led decisions
  3. 03

    UX, UI & creative design

    I lead journeys, prototypes, interface design and creative direction, shaping digital experiences that combine accessibility, ease of use and a strong sense of brand.

    • UX/UI & prototyping
    • Design systems
    • Creative direction
  4. 04

    Leadership & collaboration

    I bring senior stakeholders, clients, designers and developers around a shared direction, giving teams the clarity, challenge and support to deliver their best work.

    • Workshop facilitation
    • Team development
    • Stakeholder alignment

YoungMindsCharity · Digital transformation

Putting the right support within reach at difficult moments.

Challenge
Help young people, parents and professionals navigate a large mental-health platform when clarity and trust matter most.
My part
Led discovery, user research and UX/UI across the transformation, working directly with young people, parents and professionals.
Difference
Clearer routes to help, advice and donations, shaped around what each audience needs in the moment.
BlueprintAgency product · Design system

Turning repeated delivery problems into a reusable product.

Challenge
Teams were repeatedly solving the same set-up, component and hand-off problems at the start of each project.
My part
Set the product vision and led the design of reusable patterns, components and practical guidance.
Difference
Faster starts, clearer hand-offs and more consistent experiences across client products.
GirlguidingE-commerce · Community

Designing one shop around three distinct audiences.

Challenge
Serve parents, leaders and voluntary shop owners through one coherent e-commerce platform.

A clearer route from finding the right products to checkout, without fragmenting the experience for different audiences.
